info.title: ATLAS Engine API
info.description: Planetary disaster intelligence: normalised, correlated, provenance-tracked open data.

schema.title: Response Meta Api V1 Meta Get
Response Health Api V1 Health Get
Response Metrics View Api V1 Metrics Get
Response Incident Weather Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Weather Get

get.description: People living within distance rings (GHSL 2025). Milliseconds; requires the Population Pack.

schema.title: Response Incident Population Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Exposure Population Get

get.description: The incident's population rings counted again with WorldPop 2020, beside GHSL (rings up to 100 km).

schema.title: Response Incident Worldpop Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Exposure Worldpop Get

get.description: Overture Maps building footprints within 1, 2, 5 and 10 km (first query in a session ~1 min).

schema.title: Response Incident Buildings Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Exposure Buildings Get

get.description: Mapped facilities within distance rings (OpenStreetMap via Overpass; cached 24 h).

schema.title: Response Incident Infrastructure Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Exposure Infrastructure Get

get.description: Official USGS products as issued: ShakeMap contours, PAGER, aftershock forecast, location uncertainty.

schema.title: Response Incident Usgs Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Usgs Get

get.description: The same earthquake as reported by regional agencies (JMA, NCS India, INCOIS), matched by time and place.

schema.title: Response Incident Agencies Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Agencies Get

get.description: Raw sea level at the nearest IOC tide gauges and DART buoys around an undersea earthquake.

schema.title: Response Incident Sea Level Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Sea Level Get

get.description: Largest earthquakes nearby since 1900, and this week's activity against the 10-year rate.

schema.title: Response Incident Seismic Context Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Seismic Context Get

get.description: Residents and places inside a cyclone's forecast cone and wind zones (GHSL, Natural Earth).

schema.title: Response Incident Zone Exposure Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Exposure Zones Get

get.description: Heat against local climatology, fire weather, air quality and other hazards nearby, together.

schema.title: Response Incident Compound Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Compound Get

get.description: Official alerts with polygons (NWS, NDMA SACHET, volcanic ash SIGMETs) as GeoJSON, as issued.

schema.title: Response Alerts Layer Api V1 Alerts Layer Get

get.description: Official alerts in force at the incident's position, plus MeteoAlarm warnings for its country.

schema.title: Response Incident Alerts Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Alerts Get

get.description: Humanitarian context for a country from HDX HAPI (needs a free app identifier).

schema.title: Response Country Context Api V1 Context Country  Iso3  Get

get.description: Copernicus EMS rapid-mapping activations of the last 30 days.

schema.title: Response Cems Recent Api V1 Context Cems Get

get.description: Copernicus EMS activations matching this incident (same hazard, within 500 km and 14 days).

schema.title: Response Incident Cems Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Cems Get

get.description: Every Sentinel-2 burn-scar map on disk (computed on request or automatically), largest first.

schema.title: Response Burn Scar Gallery Api V1 Gallery Burn Scars Get

get.description: Modelled river discharge (GloFAS) near the incident, and US stream gauges when in the US.

schema.title: Response Incident Rivers Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Rivers Get

get.description: How fast a fire's detected footprint grew over the last 48 h and which way it spread (derived).

schema.title: Response Incident Fire Growth Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Fire Growth Get

get.description: Whether a local model is available (Ollama on this machine), and which.

schema.title: Response Ai Status Api V1 Ai Status Get

post.description:
Stream an answer from the local model, which may call ATLAS's read-only tools.
Events: status, tool_call, tool_result, token, reset, citations, done, error.

get.description: Latest readings from monitoring stations within 25 km (OpenAQ; needs a free API key).

schema.title: Response Incident Air Quality Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Air Quality Get

get.description: NOAA SWPC scales now (R/S/G) and SWPC's three-day outlook, quoted as issued.

schema.title: Response Space Weather Api V1 Context Space Weather Get

post.description: Residents (GHSL) and mapped facilities (OpenStreetMap) inside a drawn area (measure tool).

schema.title: Response Polygon Exposure Api V1 Exposure Polygon Post

post.description: Elevation along a (lon, lat) path from Copernicus DEM GLO-30, 64 samples (measure tool).

schema.title: Response Elevation Profile Api V1 Context Profile Post

get.description:
Base imagery and terrain tiles: from a saved offline region when there is one, else fetched
(and cached) from the original free service. The Windows app loads its globe through this.
What's here? Nearest place, elevation (Copernicus DEM), residents within 10 km (GHSL) and time zone.

schema.title: Response Point Context Api V1 Context Point Get

get.description: NOAA SWPC OVATION aurora probability (1° grid, short-term model forecast).

schema.title: Response Aurora Api V1 Context Aurora Get

get.description: Current orbits (TLE) of Sentinel-2A/B/C and Landsat 8/9 from CelesTrak, for ground tracks and overpasses.

schema.title: Response Satellites Api V1 Context Satellites Get

get.description:
Knowledge graph around an incident: documented, rule-based relations (aftershock windows,
cyclone → flood, earthquakes near volcanoes, same-hazard neighbours).

schema.title: Response Incident Graph Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Graph Get

get.description:
Earthquake shaking scenario (SIMULATION — NOT A FORECAST): median MMI bands from a published
intensity prediction equation and modelled residents inside each band.

schema.title: Response Simulate Earthquake Api V1 Simulate Earthquake Get

get.description:
Before/after change around the incident: Sentinel-2 dNBR, MNDWI or ΔNDVI, or Sentinel-1 radar water. DERIVED; 10–60 s
on first request (reads only small windows of the public COGs), then cached for 12 h.

schema.title: Response Incident Spectral Change Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Imagery Change Get

get.description: Images produced by the change analysis (validated names only; never arbitrary paths).

post.description: Re-open optional packs after installation and recompute open incidents.

schema.title: Response Packs Reload Api V1 Packs Reload Post

get.description: Data Time Machine: what ATLAS knew about this incident at a past instant.

Columnar.title: Columnar
Columnar.description: Compact column-oriented payload for map layers (one array per field).

note.title: Note
note.default: Heuristic summary of source count, agreement, review status and recency. It is not a calibrated probability.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: How a value came to exist. Surfaced on every metric in the interface.
